_readme: Source of truth for /videos/. Edit this file, then run `npx wrangler deploy`. Planned: move to a D1 `videos` table + admin page (see ../../VIDEOS.md). `id` is the 11-character YouTube video id (works for Shorts too). `important: true` shows the Important badge and includes the video in the Important filter and the homepage strip. `type` is "video" or "short". Array order is display order within a group.
